title: [review] project-LICHEN-636h.3: encode_inbox_cbor buffer overrun (P1)
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_msg.c:664

The guard `off + 100 < buf_size` in encode_inbox_cbor is insufficient for entries with body_len close to LICHEN_MSG_MAX_BODY_LEN (200). A single message entry can produce up to ~275 bytes of CBOR (map header + 4 keys + IPv6 addr up to 39 chars + body up to 200 chars + 2 timestamps), but the guard only reserves 100 bytes per entry, allowing off to advance past buf_size before the next check triggers truncation.

Impact: Out-of-bounds write to the stack-allocated cbor_buf[512] buffer.

Fix: Either replace the heuristic guard with a precise computation (e.g., check off + max_per_entry < buf_size) or pre-compute serialized size per entry before writing.
